fact: ENAPORT's Boletim Estatístico 2024, edition of September 2025, publishes port statistics (ship, cargo and container movements for 2023 and 2024, ship movement series 2003-2024) summarising data held by ENAPORT from its port operations, a transport source.
title: Boletim Estatístico 2024
publisher: ENAPORT - Empresa Nacional de Administração dos Portos
